data.body: **[P1] Allow producer-owned exception envelopes across operation boundaries.** Child contexts reuse `ErrorObject` from nested durable-operation failures, so its offloaded `errorData` remains owned by the inner operation or invoked execution. Resolving it under the child/branch context fails this check, turning an expected invoke/map/parallel failure into an invocation-level `PayloadOffloadException`. Preserve producer ownership for propagated exception payloads or rebind them before checkpointing, with a nested failure/replay test.
